help.connectText: Vocaluxe shows the QR code to connect under Options → Server. If the server is switched off there, the app cannot be reached.
help.gameText: In the game you open the queue in the song menu: press the space bar (or click the options button) and choose the playlist “{name}” under “Open playlist”. There you see the next song and all entries and can start them right away. With singers chosen and microphones set up, singing starts without the player selection; “Change players” shows the player selection.
help.httpsText: If HTTPS is switched on, Vocaluxe uses a certificate it created itself. Browsers do not know it and show a warning such as “Your connection is not private” the first time. That is expected at home: tap “Advanced” and then “Proceed” (Safari: “Show details” → “visit this website”). The connection is still encrypted. HTTPS is only needed for features like the camera; otherwise HTTP is fine.
help.playlistsText: Playlists are collections for later, e.g. “Party classics”. You can create and fill them in the app, play them in the game or add all or some of their songs to the queue with one tap.
help.previewText: The play button in the song list plays 30 seconds of a song on your phone, starting where the song menu of the game starts its preview.
help.queueText: Songs you add with your phone go to the queue. Everybody gets one song per round: if someone adds several songs, the songs of the others come in between. When adding a song you can choose game mode, audio and singers and change them later in the queue.
help.startText: With the permission to do so you can tap an entry in the queue and choose “Sing now”. The song starts right away in the game, unless someone is singing.
